intent: Allow any good-faith contributor to help develop JANUS while preserving maintainer-only authority over destructive repository changes.

technical_constraint.statement: GitHub repository write/maintain roles do not provide a fine-grained guarantee that a collaborator can edit while being technically unable to delete, rename, or move repository paths. Therefore direct write access would violate the requested authority ceiling.
technical_constraint.safe_equivalent: Public fork/PR contribution permits unlimited proposals while actual repository mutation remains behind maintainer review and merge authority.

invariants: VERIFY THE SAME THING YOU PROMOTE
FUNCTION MAY TRANSFORM — IDENTITY MUST CROSS EVERY GATE
CI GREEN IS NOT MERGE PERMISSION
CONTRIBUTOR PROPOSAL IS NOT DESTRUCTIVE AUTHORITY
